[SWS_SwCluC_CONSTR_02146] Block IDs of Application Software Clus-
ter’s Configuration ID blocks in Host Software Cluster
Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00206, SRS_BSW_00167
⌈In the NvM module of the Host Software Cluster the Configuration ID
block of an Application Software Cluster shall be configured with a lower
block ID than all the other NvBlocks of the identical Application Software Clus-
ter.⌋
Please note, that the configured Block IDs of an Application Software Clus-
ter’s NvBlock can differ in the configuration in the NvM High Proxy and the NvM of
the Host Software Cluster.
The Block ID numbers are translated during the API calls from Application Soft-
ware Cluster to the Host Software Cluster.
Hence, a valid configuration of Block IDs in the Host Software Cluster can look
like following example as shown in figure 7.12.
module
Figure 7.12: Example configuration of NvBlocks used by Application Software Clusters
